title: The multi-supplier price importer drops every refused row with no count, no reason and no panel
evidence: out/pricelist/09b-multi-preview.png + out/pricelist/09-preview.json. Fixture pricelist-B.csv carries 8 data rows; the preview header reads "2 שורות זוהו. ההתאמה מתבצעת לפי שם ספק ושם מוצר מדויקים." and the modal contains zero <details> elements, zero toasts and no skipped count. Six rows (comma-decimal 12,50 / text לא ידוע / -3 / 12.50 USD / 12.50 EUR / a supplier the org does not have) were parsed, refused and discarded. Code: PriceLists.tsx ImportModal.onFile does `const { valid } = mapRows(...)` — mapRows returns {valid, skipped} and `skipped` is never bound. The sister modal (PriceListUpload.tsx) binds it and renders it, so the same product shows the reasons on one door and hides them on the other.
repro: Sign in as office → /prices → "ייבוא רב־ספקים מ־Excel" → upload a CSV with columns ספק,מוצר,מחיר in which some price cells are unreadable → read the row count in the preview header and compare with the number of data rows in the file.
expected: Every row that did not reach the preview is reported with its source row number and the reason it was refused, as the per-supplier upload modal already does.
actual: The preview states only how many rows survived. Six of eight rows vanished with no error anywhere — zero console errors, zero failed requests, HTTP 200 throughout.

title: The import abort names a row number that belongs to a different row, and one unmatched row discards the whole file
evidence: out/pricelist/10-pathB-import.json — toast captured verbatim: "הייבוא בוטל: ספק או מוצר לא נמצאו בשם מדויק בשורות 3." The only unresolvable line in pricelist-B.csv is "מוצר שלא קיים QA" on FILE ROW 9. File row 3 is "תפוחי אדמה,12,50" — a row the screen never displayed and whose problem is a comma decimal, not a missing product. The network trace for the same click shows suppliers?select=id,name and products?select=id,name were fetched and rpc/import_supplier_prices was never called. Code: PriceLists.tsx ImportModal.runImport does `unresolved.push(index + 2)` where `index` walks the FILTERED preview array, so the number is the position after PL-01 removed rows; and `if (unresolved.length) { toast(...); return; }` aborts before the RPC.
repro: As PL-01, then press "אישור וייבוא" with one product name that is not in the catalogue.
expected: The message names the source row in the uploaded file; and the rows that do resolve are either imported or the refusal explains that the file is all-or-nothing.
actual: The user is told to fix row 3, which is not the offending row. 8 rows in, 0 rows written, and the one row that matched (עגבניות 9.50) was discarded with them.

title: A successful price-list import is recorded in the ledger as "שורת מחירון שנמחקה" with "אין נתוני מחיר", and it is the only row that carries the reason
evidence: out/pricelist/14a-supplier-log.png and out/pricelist/14-audit.json. Two imports were run (16-row fixture, then a 6-row restore), each with a typed reason. The ledger shows for each: subject "שורת מחירון שנמחקה", type "מחירון", action "קליטת מחירון", change "אין נתוני מחיר", reason "בדיקת QA — סריקת רגרסיה 04.09.2026" / "בדיקת QA — שחזור מחירים מקוריים 04.09.2026". Nothing was deleted — the same import updated six prices (rpc returned {"created":0,"updated":6,"rejected":0,"row_count":6}). The 12 per-row rows beneath it all read "לא נרשמה סיבה". Code: SupplierLog.tsx builds `subject` as `[identity?.product?.name, supplierName].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') || t('supplierLog.filter')`, and supplierLog.filter is the literal "שורת מחירון שנמחקה"; the supplier_prices_imported command row has entity_type supplier_products but an entity_id that is not a supplier_products row, so the lookup misses and the fallback asserts a deletion.
repro: office: /prices → העלאת מחירון → import any sheet with a typed reason. owner: /supplier-log.
expected: The import command row names the import (supplier, row count) and the reason reaches the price rows it explains; a row is called deleted only when something was deleted.
actual: The audit ledger states a deletion that did not happen, and a manager asking "why did this price change?" is told "לא נרשמה סיבה" on every row while the reason sits on the row labelled as a deletion. NOTE: SupplierLog.tsx is not in this deploy's changed-file list, so this is almost certainly long-standing and merely first exposed now — the previous sweep imported 0 rows and so never produced this ledger row.

title: A named server refusal is shown to the user as "contact support", while the screen already displays the actual cause one line above
evidence: out/pricelist/17-dryrun.json and out/pricelist/17a-dryrun-error.png. Wire: POST rpc/get_qualified_product_creation_dry_run → HTTP 400 {"code":"22023","message":"qualified_product_dry_run_context_invalid"}. Screen: "בדיקת הכשירות נכשלה: הפעולה נכשלה. אם הבעיה חוזרת — פנה לתמיכה." The refusal condition is supabase/migrations/0182_qualified_product_creation_guards.sql:136 — document_kind <> 'price_list' OR supplier_id IS NULL — and the same panel prints "הספק שהוצע בפירוש: לא זוהה" directly above the failure. grep across src/ and supabase/ finds the string qualified_product_dry_run_context_invalid only at the raise site: the client has no mapping for it.
repro: Open a price-list document that has no supplier attached at /documents/:id/review and read the readiness panel; capture the network response for get_qualified_product_creation_dry_run.
expected: "This price list is not attached to a supplier — attach one and the readiness check can run." An instruction, since the app knows the cause.
actual: "The action failed. If it keeps happening, contact support." A cause the server named exactly is replaced by a support ticket.

title: An approved canonical product name is the name shown everywhere, and a price list using it imports as a NEW product
evidence: out/pricelist/06-preview.json + out/pricelist/06b-preview-skipped.png. Catalogue product bb000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000040 is stored as name "סבון ידיים נוזלי 4 ליטר" with an approved display_name "סבון ידיים נוזלי — 4 ליטר" (out/pricelist/03-raw.json). /prices and /products render display_name (format.ts productLabel). A fixture row carrying the displayed name previews as "מוצר חדש". The importer matches on products.name via nameKey, which strips quotes and collapses whitespace but not an em dash.
repro: Copy a product label off /products for a product whose name has been approved, put it in a price sheet, upload via העלאת מחירון.
expected: A name the product screen itself displays resolves to that product, or the preview says the row matched a canonical name.
actual: It is offered as a new catalogue product; ticking "צור מוצר חדש" would create a second product for the same item — the exact duplication the approval queue exists to reduce.

title: The screen promises "כל אישור נרשם ביומן הביקורת" and no screen in the product can read that entry
evidence: Approval measured end to end: out/pricelist/13-approve.json — product "מלח גס" display_name null → "מלח גס", rpc set_product_display_name returned {"idempotent":false,"product_id":"bb000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000027","display_name":"מלח גס"}, queue tab 270 → 269, verified on a fresh load of /products. The corresponding audit row is not reachable: SupplierLog.tsx declares "The two entity types this log covers" as suppliers and supplier_products only, and the live entity filter offers exactly ["כל העדכונים","פרטי ספק","מחירון"] (out/pricelist/14-audit.json). grep for audit_logs reads across src/pages and src/components returns SupplierLog.tsx alone.
repro: office: /products → "שמות לאישור" → אישור on any card. owner: /supplier-log → no entity filter can reach it.
expected: Either the log is reachable, or the screen does not promise a ledger the user cannot open.
actual: The write and its reason land in audit_logs under entity products, which no customer-facing screen queries.

title: Rounding a price to the currency's minor units is silent, although the parser computes a flag saying it happened
evidence: Fixture row "בצל יבש","1.2345" previewed as "1.23 ₪" with no marker, imported, and reads 1.23 on a fresh load (out/pricelist/08-after.json). src/lib/price.ts returns `rounded: discardedDigits(...)` and its own docblock states the contract as "the value is rounded to the currency's own minor units, and says so when rounding changed it"; grep for the flag across src/ shows neither consumer (PriceListUpload.tsx, PriceLists.tsx) ever reads `parsed.rounded`.
repro: Put a price with more decimals than the currency has minor units in a sheet and import it.
expected: The preview marks the row as rounded, as price.ts was written to allow.
actual: The supplier quoted 1.2345 and the catalogue holds 1.23, with nothing on any screen recording that the number changed.

title: The approval queue presents the entire catalogue as pending work; most cards state that approving them changes nothing
evidence: out/pricelist/12b-name-queue.png, out/pricelist/12-namequeue.json. Page subtitle "270 שמות ממתינים לאישור", tab "שמות לאישור (270)" against 270 distinct catalogue products (out/pricelist/03-raw.json). The majority of cards read "זהה לשם השמור — האישור מסמן שנבדק, ואינו משנה את מה שמוצג." The reversed-name cards are correctly detected and say so ("שם ככל הנראה שמור בסדר הפוך — לא ניתן להציע לו שם קנוני") and offer "עריכה ואישור" as a manual exit, so the exit exists; the problem is the count offered as work.
expected: The count offered as work reflects the names that would actually change — the ~39 reversed ones this tenant has — with the confirm-only rest separated.
actual: A 270-item queue in which the rows that need a human are mixed into a majority of no-ops. Related: the sibling tab "תיקון ממקור" reads "(—)" and produced nothing.

title: Hebrew number agreement in the import preview: "1 מוצרים חדשים" and "צור מוצר חדש אחד … ועדכן את מחירם"
evidence: out/pricelist/06b-preview-skipped.png — "זוהו 7 שורות … 6 הותאמו למוצרים קיימים, 1 מוצרים חדשים" and the checkbox "צור מוצר חדש אחד בקטלוג ועדכן את מחירם". priceUpload.newProductsWord is a fixed plural string with no count-dependent form.
repro: Import a sheet in which exactly one row is an unknown product.
actual: Plural noun with the numeral 1, and a plural possessive for a single product. (`npm run check:plurals` is one of the 13 verify guards CLAUDE.md records as not running in any workflow.)

title: The multi-supplier importer resolves names against an unpaged catalogue read — NOT REPRODUCED, code-level only
evidence: Live request captured during the import click: products?select=id%2Cname with no range and no limit (out/pricelist/10-pathB-import.json). PriceListUpload.tsx uses fetchAll() with explicit .range() for the same lookup; PriceLists.tsx ImportModal does not. With PostgREST's default row ceiling, every product past the cap would resolve as "not found" and, via PL-02, abort the entire import. This tenant holds 270 products, so the cap was never reached and the defect was NOT observed live.
repro: Not reproduced. Would need a catalogue larger than the PostgREST max-rows setting.
expected: The same paged read the sister modal uses.
actual: A single unpaged select; reported as latent, with the caveat that it was not triggered.

title: A supplier price list classified as "הצעת מחיר" has no route to becoming prices, and a second one has been "בעיבוד" with 79 rows and no result
evidence: out/pricelist/16-reviews.json, out/pricelist/16-ahim-kohen.png, out/pricelist/16-paamit.png. "אחים כהן מחירון.pdf" (3 pages): active classification "הצעת מחיר", the panel "מה יקרה באישור" reads "לסוג המסמך הזה אין עדיין מסלול אישור", and only 2 item lines were saved from 3 pages. "פעמית מחירון.pdf": "תוצאות העלאת המחירון האחרונה — המערכת קוראת את המחירון ומתאימה את השורות. התוצאה תופיע כאן בסיום. בעיבוד", with "מספר שורות שזוהו 79" and no result; and "האישור זמין רק למעלה המסמך בתפקיד בעלים, משרד או ספק", so an office user who did not upload it cannot act at all.
expected: A supplier price list reaches a screen where its lines can be matched and imported, or the screen says which single action unblocks it.
actual: One is a dead end behind a mis-classification (the exit "הסיווג שגוי? תיקון סוג" exists but the blocking panel does not point at it), and the other is parked in "בעיבוד". Both belong partly to the documents/OCR surface — recorded here because they are the only two price-list documents this tenant has.

title: The two intake doors answer "which line is which product?" by different keys — name in the sheet importer, SKU/barcode only in the document reviewer
evidence: The same 16 lines measured through both doors. Sheet importer: 6 matched existing products by name, 1 offered as new, 9 refused by name (out/pricelist/06-preview.json). Document reviewer for the very same file: "0 מתוך 16 שורות זוהו במלואן — מוצר קיים ומחיר · 16 שורות לא זוהו אוטומטית", and the panel states the rule outright: "התאימה את השורות שניתן לזהות לפי מק״ט או ברקוד; שם מוצר לעולם אינו מפתח התאמה" (out/pricelist/17-dryrun.json).
repro: Import a sheet through /prices, then open the same file as a document at /documents/:id/review.
expected: Not necessarily one rule — but a manager comparing the two screens gets 6/16 and 0/16 for the same file.
actual: The document path is explicit about its rule and offers "טיפול בשורות שנותרו" as a manual exit, so this is a consistency observation rather than a defect. Recorded because it is the likeliest explanation of the previous sweep's "0 of 74 lines": a supplier PDF whose lines carry no SKU the org holds can never auto-match on that path.
